_purpose: Cross-reference for the 13 CM dates flagged as payload-identical to the prior trading day (see scripts/buildNseCoverageReport.js). This is NOT an NSE-sourced file -- VIKRAM has no ingested official NSE holiday circular. It is a manually-researched cross-reference built from public secondary sources, used only to classify each duplicate date as LIKELY_HOLIDAY or UNRESOLVED, never to silently delete or relabel data.
_limitation: Sources are third-party holiday-calendar publishers (smallcase.com, stablemoney.in, ebc.com, thiyagi.com), not the primary NSE circular (NSE/CMTR/71775 for 2026; the equivalent 2025 circular was not directly fetched -- this sandbox's network egress does not permit reaching nseindia.com). This file is evidence, not proof of NSE source authenticity per forensic finding P1-09.
